mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_customer WHERE create_time >= #{monthStart}) AS "newCustomers", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_customer WHERE owner_id IS NOT NULL) AS "ownedCustomers", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_customer c LEFT JOIN crm_customer x ON x.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.status = 1 AND x.owner_id IS NULL) AS "poolCustomers", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_lead WHERE create_time >= #{monthStart}) AS "newLeads", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_lead WHERE convert_time >= #{monthStart}) AS "convertedLeads", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_opportunity WHERE stage NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST')) AS "openOpps", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM crm_opportunity WHERE stage NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST')) AS "pipeline", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount * probability / 100), 0) FROM crm_opportunity WHERE stage NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST')) AS "weightedPipeline", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_opportunity WHERE stage = 'WON' AND close_date >= #{monthStart}) AS "wonCount", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM crm_opportunity WHERE stage = 'WON' AND close_date >= #{monthStart}) AS "wonAmount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_opportunity WHERE stage = 'WON') AS "wonTotal", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_opportunity WHERE stage = 'LOST') AS "lostTotal", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_ticket WHERE status IN ('OPEN', 'PROCESSING')) AS "openTickets", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_ticket WHERE status IN ('OPEN', 'PROCESSING') AND due_time < #{now}) AS "overdueTickets", (SELECT AVG(satisfaction) FROM crm_ticket WHERE satisfaction IS NOT NULL) AS "satisfaction"
SELECT COALESCE(x.stage, 'POTENTIAL') AS "stage", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM scm_customer c LEFT JOIN crm_customer x ON x.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.status = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(x.stage, 'POTENTIAL')
SELECT stage AS "stage", COUNT(*) AS "count", COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS "amount" FROM crm_opportunity GROUP BY stage
SELECT to_stage AS "stage", COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id) AS "count" FROM crm_stage_log GROUP BY to_stage

SELECT c.id AS "customerId", c.code AS "code", c.name AS "name", u.nickname AS "ownerName", CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN d.biz_date END) AS CHAR(10)) AS "lastDate", SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "frequency", SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN d.total_amount ELSE -d.total_amount END) AS "monetary" FROM scm_trade_doc d JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = d.partner_id LEFT JOIN crm_customer x ON x.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = x.owner_id WHERE d.kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND d.biz_date >= #{since} GROUP BY c.id, c.code, c.name, u.nickname HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN d.kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

SELECT YEAR(biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(biz_date) AS "period", SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN total_amount ELSE -total_amount END) AS "amount", COUNT(DISTINCT partner_id) AS "customers" FROM scm_trade_doc WHERE kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND biz_date >= #{since} GROUP BY YEAR(biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(biz_date)

SELECT YEAR(close_date) * 100 + MONTH(close_date) AS "period", COUNT(*) AS "count", SUM(amount) AS "amount" FROM crm_opportunity WHERE stage = 'WON' AND close_date >= #{since} GROUP BY YEAR(close_date) * 100 + MONTH(close_date)

SELECT s.source AS "source", COALESCE(l.leads, 0) AS "leads", COALESCE(l.converted, 0) AS "converted", COALESCE(o.opps, 0) AS "opps", COALESCE(o.won_amount, 0) AS "wonAmount" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(source, 'OTHER') AS source FROM crm_lead UNION SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(source, 'OTHER') FROM crm_opportunity) s LEFT JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(source, 'OTHER') AS source, COUNT(*) AS leads, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'CONVERTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS converted FROM crm_lead GROUP BY COALESCE(source, 'OTHER')) l ON l.source = s.source LEFT JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(source, 'OTHER') AS source, COUNT(*) AS opps, SUM(CASE WHEN stage = 'WON' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS won_amount FROM crm_opportunity GROUP BY COALESCE(source, 'OTHER')) o ON o.source = s.source

SELECT u.id AS "userId", u.nickname AS "name", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_customer x WHERE x.owner_id = u.id) AS "customers", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_opportunity o WHERE o.owner_id = u.id AND o.stage NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST')) AS "openOpps", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) FROM crm_opportunity o WHERE o.owner_id = u.id AND o.stage NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST')) AS "pipeline", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_opportunity o WHERE o.owner_id = u.id AND o.stage = 'WON' AND o.close_date >= #{yearStart}) AS "wonCount", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) FROM crm_opportunity o WHERE o.owner_id = u.id AND o.stage = 'WON' AND o.close_date >= #{yearStart}) AS "wonAmount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_followup f WHERE f.create_by = u.id AND f.follow_time >= #{monthStart}) AS "followups" FROM sys_user u WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_customer x WHERE x.owner_id = u.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_opportunity o WHERE o.owner_id = u.id)

SELECT COALESCE(x.industry, 'UNKNOWN') AS "industry", COUNT(*) AS "customers", COALESCE(SUM(s.sales), 0) AS "sales" FROM scm_customer c LEFT JOIN crm_customer x ON x.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT partner_id, SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'SALES_OUT' THEN total_amount ELSE -total_amount END) AS sales FROM scm_trade_doc WHERE kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND biz_date >= #{since} GROUP BY partner_id) s ON s.partner_id = c.id WHERE c.status = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(x.industry, 'UNKNOWN')

SELECT type AS "type", COUNT(*) AS "count", SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('OPEN', 'PROCESSING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "open", AVG(CASE WHEN resolved_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, create_time, resolved_time) END) AS "avgMinutes", SUM(CASE WHEN resolved_time IS NOT NULL AND resolved_time <= due_time THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "onTime", SUM(CASE WHEN resolved_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "resolved", AVG(satisfaction) AS "satisfaction" FROM crm_ticket GROUP BY type
